title: DISABLED test_vae_cuda (__main__.TestModels)
bug_description:
Platforms: rocm

  This test was disabled because it is failing in CI. See [recent examples](https://hud.pytorch.org/flakytest?name=test_vae_cuda&suite=TestModels&limit=100) and the most recent trunk [workflow logs](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/runs/49105108137).

  Over the past 6 hours, it has been determined flaky in 8 workflow(s) with 16 failures and 8 successes.

  **Debugging instructions (after clicking on the recent samples link):**
  DO NOT ASSUME THINGS ARE OKAY IF THE CI IS GREEN. We now shield flaky tests from developers so CI will thus be green but it will be harder to parse the logs.
  To find relevant log snippets:
  1. Click on the workflow logs linked above
  2. Click on the Test step of the job so that it is expanded. Otherwise, the grepping will not work.
  3. Grep for `test_vae_cuda`
  4. There should be several instances run (as flaky tests are rerun in CI) from which you can study the logs.

error_description: This test was disabled because it is failing in CI on ROCm platform. The test is flaky with 16 failures and 8 successes over the past 6 hours. The error shows an AssertionError indicating that tensor-likes are not close when comparing gradients. There are 844 mismatched elements out of 100352 (0.8%), with greatest absolute difference of 5.346536636352539e-05 at index (31, 0, 15, 8) and greatest relative difference of 0.4476863741874695 at index (31, 0, 13, 27).
